vibe_rationale: Long-running, curated literary festival loved by its community, but mainstream literary and heavily sponsor-branded (51 listed partners), so not a subculture peer.
fit_notes: Adult, book-buying audience with little wellness or lifestyle adjacency; a wellbeing talks strand is the only health hook. The partners page and over 10,000 attendance across three days show it takes brands, though audience demographics are not published; it is an NSW event, so direct activation is possible.
